Remark
[structural remark on reduced length] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Remark 4\group Kleiner–Lott Surgery Existence

The hypothesis concerns reduced lengths of barely admissible curves, including curves that meet a surgery slice.

Proof

\sketch Use the reduced-length and reduced-volume identities, the maximum principle, and the cited surgery estimates; the resulting barriers give the stated bound. ↗ lem:kl-reduced-l-geometry-existence-ricci-flow-surgery ↗ lem:kl-reduced-l-geometry-positivity-reduced-l-geometry
